📢 Fully Funded PhD Opportunity - Kenya 🇰🇪
United States International University-Africa USIU-Africa | Department of International Relations
WATERSHED PROJECT: Climate justice, vulnerability, and informal urban adaptation in Kenya
Contact: watershedscolar@usiu.ac.ke | Enquiries: Njoki Wamai - nwamai@usiu.ac.ke

Program: PhD in International Relations
Duration: 4 years | Start: September 2026
Deadline: August 17, 2026
Location: Nairobi, Kenya. Fieldwork in Mathare, Pumwani and Korogocho informal settlements

Project focus:
WATERSHED is a Danida Fellowship Centre funded project exploring informal climate adaptation to flooding in Nairobi. Investigates tension between policies/government actions that increase vulnerability and everyday climate justice actions by community activists. Research on perceived vulnerabilities, climate justice actions, and local adaptation initiatives related to flooding

Funding:
- Fully funded with competitive stipend and educational fees
- Includes 3-month research stay at Roskilde University, Denmark

Eligibility:
- Master’s Degree in International Relations, Political Science, Sociology, Human Geography, Anthropology or Development Studies
- Bachelor’s Degree Upper Second Class and above in above disciplines
- Experience working with communities in informal settlements and/or passion for study area
- Proficiency in mixed methods, qualitative and quantitative analysis e.g. NVIVO and SPSS
- Oral and written English at academic level; Swahili and one other Kenyan vernacular language
- Willing to do at least 9 months fieldwork and full-time commitment for 4 years

Supervisors:
Main: Assistant Professor Njoki Wamai, USIU-Africa
Co-supervisors: Associate Professor Somdeep Sen, Roskilde University & Professor Hussein Mahmood, USIU-Africa

Apply: Send single PDF with:
1. 3-page Concept Note aligned with project theme
2. 1-page Motivation Statement
3. Degree Certificates and Academic Transcripts
4. Max 3-page Resume with 2 referees
5. 2 Reference letters sent directly by referees
Email: watershedscolar@usiu.ac.ke
Note: AI-generated concept notes will not be considered

More info: https://t.co/94De0Q2B1h

#PhD #InternationalRelations #ClimateJustice #WATERSHED #USIUAfrica #Nairobi
